distribution.summary: 福建；广东；广西；贵州；云南；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010), under the name Xyleborus pinicola, records China (SE) and provides the first Taiwan record from Nantou, Hui Son, 18.iii.2006. The broad China (SE) wording is not expanded into provinces.

host_note: Smith et al. (2020) supports Pinus kesiya, P. massoniana, P. yunnanensis and P. taiwanensis. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Pinus spp.; this is retained as genus-level corroboration and does not replace or expand the species-level host synthesis.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborus festivus Eichhoff, 1876.

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Xyleborus festivus Eichhoff, 1876, VSN_6220. Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Xyleborus pinicola and synonymizes Xyleborus pinivorus Browne under X. pinicola; the source name is mapped to the current canonical identity without creating a duplicate taxon.
